currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful aerial/front photographs plus standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke survey sources or photograph redistribution.

pictures.observations: Close elevated view: wide faceted main drum/conical stone roof, lower gray metal crossing roofs, open two-stage western bell portico, small open roof belfries and broad lower flat eastern range. Stone course bands, vertical windows, triangular gables and stepped plinth are readable. Museum/roof role splits and exact ornament are estimates.

West front: round lower entry arch, much larger open upper gallery with triangular pediment, octagonal arched bell pavilion, conical stone roof/cross, two smaller flank roof belfries, repeated cornices and pale warm stone with carved motifs. Exact reliefs, inscriptions and full interiors are not reconstructed.
